correctness.summary: For an outside vertex in a multipartite part V_i, its representation is determined exactly by s_i=|S∩V_i|. This forces at most one omission per part and makes omissions from two parts compatible exactly when their part sizes differ. The resulting lower and upper bounds match, and the basis enumeration follows bijectively.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2019 foundational complete-multipartite proposition treats only equal part sizes, while the 2023 primary source explicitly states the balanced and pairwise-distinct part-size cases but not the mixed repeated-size regime. The full 2025 joined-graphs paper and a 2026 survey likewise do not state the arbitrary complete-multipartite formula. No material inaccessible source was identified among the closest references; very recent or poorly indexed parallel work remains the principal residual risk.

value.summary: The theorem closes the natural gap between two known complete-multipartite endpoint cases, explains the role of repeated size classes, characterizes every outer multiset resolving set, and gives exact basis and resolving-set counts.

limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The finite computation is only a sanity check and is not used in the proof.
